text: August 30, 2019 - Originally from central Congo, the Tetela compose songs mainly drawing inspiration from history and the daily life in their villages. The mnemonic dimension of the music becomes easier to understand once you realise that track 3 is a song of collective rejoicing, and that is sung to honour the ‘researcher/traveller/celebrated jazzman’ Benoît Quersin, who recorded these chants and visited the village almost 22 years after his first stay in 1953.
